value_stream.name: Packaging, Pallet & Returnable Transport Item (RTI) Management

fields.Participants: SCM, Packaging Eng, Logistics (links to VS-06), DC Operations (links to VS-04), Finance (links to VS-17/VS-35), Procurement (links to VS-03/VS-34), Sustainability (links to VS-25)
fields.Trigger: Annual SCM planning (links to VS-33.1); network change

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "SCM/Procurement establish the pool program" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-563 (ensure controlled execution — Pallet & RTI Pool, Tracking & Reconciliation (PA-111.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Strategy-mismatch risk**: Owning where renting is cheaper (or vice-versa); mitigated by TCO modeling
- **Standard-fragmentation risk**: Mixed pallet types disrupt handling/automation; mitigated by standardization
System Touchpoints: - Asset/pool master (links to VS-35/VS-29); logistics/DC (links to VS-06/VS-04); finance/TCO (links to VS-17/VS-35); procurement (links to VS-03/VS-34); sustainability (links to VS-25)

steps.activity: SCM/Packaging Eng set the pallet/RTI pool strategy: owned vs rented/pooled (e.g., CHEP/LOSAL) vs exchange, pallet type/standard (EUR/ISO/stringer/plastic), RTI types (totes, roll cages, stillages, IBCs) by use-case, pool sizing and safety float, and the build-vs-rent economics; align to network volume (links to VS-04/VS-06) and sustainability (links to VS-25)

SCM/Finance model the total cost of ownership (TCO) per strategy: owned-pallet capex/depreciation (links to VS-35), storage/handling, loss/write-off (W3533), retrieval/reverse (W3535), and rented-pool per-trip fees/deposits; select the optimal mix by lane/volume

SCM/Procurement establish the pool program: pool-provider contracts (links to VS-03/VS-34), exchange agreements with vendors/carriers (W3532), deposit accounting (links to VS-17/W3514), and the asset-master/RTI-tracking setup (links to VS-35/VS-29/W3531); report to governance (W3544)

fields.Participants: SCM, DC Operations (links to VS-04), Procurement (links to VS-03/VS-34), Finance (links to VS-35/VS-17), Master Data (links to VS-29), Supplier

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-import of "SCM/Procurement procure owned pallets per spec" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-track of "track pallet stock by location" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-count of "SCM/Finance manage pallet asset accounting" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-563 (ensure controlled execution — Pallet & RTI Pool, Tracking & Reconciliation (PA-111.2).)
- operational: safety float and forecasting; operational: spec and inspection
Pain Points / Risks: - **Stockout risk**: Pallet shortage halts putaway/shipping; mitigated by safety float and forecasting
- **ISPM-15 risk**: Non-compliant wood pallets breach import rules (links to VS-87); mitigated by spec and inspection
System Touchpoints: - Asset register (links to VS-35); DC/WMS (links to VS-04); procurement (links to VS-03/VS-34); inventory valuation (links to VS-17/W275); ISPM-15/quality (links to VS-87/VS-31); location master (links to VS-29)

steps.activity: SCM/Procurement procure owned pallets per spec (W3529): RFQ/framework (links to VS-03), supplier qualification, quality/ISPM-15 compliance for wood (links to VS-87/VS-31), lead time, and price (timber/plastic commodity links to VS-106); manage make-vs-buy and import (links to VS-02.2)

DC/SCM manage pallet inventory: track pallet stock by location (links to VS-29/W3531), issue pallets to putaway/pick/ship (links to VS-04.2), manage safety float, repair/maintenance of damaged pallets, and disposal of unserviceable pallets (links to VS-35.3/VS-73); register owned pallets as assets (links to VS-35)

SCM/Finance manage pallet asset accounting: capitalization/depreciation (links to VS-35), pallet-inventory valuation (links to VS-17/W275), and pallet cost allocation to operations (links to W3514); track pallet utilization and idle stock

fields.Participants: SCM, DC Operations (links to VS-04), Store (links to VS-07), Logistics (links to VS-06), Master Data (links to VS-29), IT (links to VS-27)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-track of "SCM/IT establish RTI tracking" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-scan of "scan in/out, capture custody" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-log of "SCM conduct cycle reconciliation of RTI by type/location/custody vs" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: RFID/barcode and reconciliation; operational: scan-in/out discipline
Pain Points / Risks: - **Tracking-blindspot risk**: Untracked RTI leads to loss and stockouts; mitigated by RFID/barcode and reconciliation
- **Custody-dispute risk**: Ambiguous custody causes loss disputes; mitigated by scan-in/out discipline
System Touchpoints: - RTI master/RFID (links to VS-29/VS-23/VS-27); WMS (links to VS-04); TMS (links to VS-27); store/DC (links to VS-07.3/VS-04); cycle count (links to VS-05.1)

steps.activity: SCM/IT establish RTI tracking: barcode/RFID tagging of totes/cages/stillages/IBCs (links to VS-29/VS-23), the RTI master and lifecycle states (in-DC, in-transit, at-store, at-customer, at-carrier, in-repair), and the tracking system (TMS/WMS links to VS-27); define the reconciliation cadence

DC/Logistics/Store track RTI movement on every shipment/receipt (links to VS-04/VS-06/VS-07.3): scan in/out, capture custody (DC, carrier, store, customer), and update state; manage exceptions (unscanned, wrong-location, overdue)

SCM conduct cycle reconciliation of RTI by type/location/custody vs the master (links to VS-05.1 cycle-count methodology), investigate variances (loss W3533, mis-scan, mis-placement), and recover mis-placed RTI (W3535); report RTI availability, utilization, and loss to analytics (W3540) and governance (W3544)

fields.Participants: SCM, Logistics (links to VS-06), Trade Sales (links to VS-11), DC (links to VS-04), Store (links to VS-07), Finance/AR (links to VS-16/VS-15), Carrier (links to VS-110), Customer
fields.Trigger: Pallet/RTI transferred to customer/carrier; exchange program

workflows.name: Pallet / RTI Deposit, Transfer & Customer / Carrier Exchange

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "accountability, and the accounting treatment" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-scan of "scan pallets/RTI out to the customer/carrier, capture deposit liability,…" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-reconcile of "reconcile the deposit pool" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-563 (ensure controlled execution — Pallet & RTI Pool, Tracking & Reconciliation (PA-111.2).)
- operational: deposit discipline and reconciliation; operational: simple terms and scan discipline
Pain Points / Risks: - **Deposit-leakage risk**: Unreturned pallets/RTI not charged; mitigated by deposit discipline and reconciliation
- **Exchange-friction risk**: Cumbersome exchange drives customer dissatisfaction; mitigated by simple terms and scan discipline
System Touchpoints: - WMS/scan (links to VS-04/VS-06); deposit liability (links to VS-17); AR (links to VS-16); trade accounts (links to VS-11/VS-43); carrier contract (links to VS-110/W3499)

steps.activity: SCM/Trade establish the pallet/RTI deposit and exchange terms: deposit value per pallet/RTI, exchange (like-for-like) vs transfer, customer/carrier accountability, and the accounting treatment (deposit liability links to VS-17); communicate to trade accounts (links to VS-11/VS-43) and carriers (links to VS-110/W3499)

DC/Store/Logistics execute the exchange/transfer on delivery (links to VS-06/VS-07.3/VS-74): scan pallets/RTI out to the customer/carrier, capture deposit liability, collect exchanged pallets/RTI on the next delivery, and reconcile; manage exceptions (short-return, damaged)

Finance/AR manage the deposit accounting: post deposit liability on transfer (links to VS-17), refund/credit on return, charge for unreturned/damaged (W3533), and reconcile the deposit pool; report deposit liability and exchange compliance to analytics (W3540)

fields.Participants: SCM, Finance (links to VS-17/VS-35), DC (links to VS-04), Loss Prevention (links to VS-23), Logistics (links to VS-06), AP/AR (links to VS-15/VS-16)

workflows.name: Pallet / RTI Loss, Damage & Write-Off Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-assign of "SCM/Loss Prevention investigate pallet/RTI loss and damage" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-capture of "capture repair cost vs replacement" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report loss/damage rate and recovery to analytics" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-563 (ensure controlled execution — Pallet & RTI Pool, Tracking & Reconciliation (PA-111.2).)
- operational: root-cause and recovery; operational: cost thresholds
Pain Points / Risks: - **Loss-acceptance risk**: Chronic loss accepted as cost-of-doing-business; mitigated by root-cause and recovery
- **Repair-vs-replace-misjudgment risk**: Repairing uneconomical pallets; mitigated by cost thresholds
System Touchpoints: - Loss prevention (links to VS-23); asset write-off (links to VS-17/VS-35.3); AP/AR recovery (links to VS-15/VS-16); waste (links to VS-73); analytics (links to W3540)

steps.activity: SCM/Loss Prevention investigate pallet/RTI loss and damage: root-cause (theft links to VS-23, mis-placement, carrier loss, customer non-return, damage in handling), quantify the loss by type/location/custody, and assign responsibility/recovery (carrier charge W3511, customer charge W3532, internal write-off)

SCM/DC manage damaged pallet/RTI: repair where economical, refurbish, or scrap/dispose sustainably (links to VS-35.3/VS-73); capture repair cost vs replacement; manage the repair vendor (links to VS-34.2)

Finance/SCM manage the write-off and recovery: write off unrecovered loss to GL (links to VS-17/VS-35), recover from responsible party (carrier/customer charge links to VS-15/VS-16), and report loss/damage rate and recovery to analytics (W3540) and loss prevention (links to VS-23); drive reduction

fields.Participants: SCM, DC Operations (links to VS-04.1), Vendor Management (links to VS-03), AP (links to VS-15), Packaging Eng, Quality (links to VS-31)
fields.Trigger: Inbound receipt (links to VS-04.1); vendor packaging terms (W3525)

workflows.name: Inbound Vendor Pallet / RTI Compliance & Chargeback

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-communication of "communicate via PO and vendor portal" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "DC inspect inbound pallet/RTI compliance on receipt" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track vendor compliance in the scorecard" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: inspection and deduction; operational: standard enforcement
Pain Points / Risks: - **Non-compliance-acceptance risk**: Non-conforming pallets accepted without chargeback; mitigated by inspection and deduction
- **Handling-disruption risk**: Wrong pallet types disrupt DC putaway/automation; mitigated by standard enforcement
System Touchpoints: - Receiving/inspection (links to VS-04.1/W1365); vendor portal (links to VS-03.4); chargeback (links to VS-03/W245); AP (links to VS-15); vendor scorecard (links to VS-67); hazmat (links to VS-24.3)

steps.activity: SCM/Packaging Eng define inbound pallet/RTI requirements in vendor terms (links to W3525): pallet type/standard, palletization pattern, stretch-wrap/strapping, label/placard, ISPM-15 (links to VS-87), and exchange/returnable terms; communicate via PO and vendor portal (links to VS-03.4)

DC inspect inbound pallet/RTI compliance on receipt (links to VS-04.1/W1365): pallet type/condition, pattern, labeling, hazmat (links to VS-24.3), and exchange pallets (W3532); document non-compliance (wrong type, sub-standard, non-conforming ISPM-15) with evidence

SCM/AP manage the chargeback for non-compliance (links to VS-03/W245): compute the cost/penalty, deduct on AP (links to VS-15) or vendor credit, dispute resolution, and track vendor compliance in the scorecard (links to VS-67/W3512); drive improvement

fields.Participants: SCM, Logistics (links to VS-06/VS-32), DC (links to VS-04), Store (links to VS-07), Carrier (links to VS-110), Customer (links to VS-11)
fields.Trigger: RTI at external locations (stores, customers, carriers); retrieval cycle

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Logistics plan RTI retrieval from external locations" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-scan of "scan in on return to DC" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report to analytics" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-563 (ensure controlled execution — Pallet & RTI Pool, Tracking & Reconciliation (PA-111.2).)
- operational: tracking and retrieval; operational: backhaul consolidation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Stranded-RTI risk**: RTI stranded at customers/carriers erodes pool; mitigated by tracking and retrieval
- **Retrieval-cost risk**: Inefficient retrieval costs more than the RTI; mitigated by backhaul consolidation
System Touchpoints: - RTI tracking (links to W3531); reverse logistics (links to VS-32); logistics/backhaul (links to VS-06/W3507); DC (links to VS-04); customer/carrier (links to VS-11/VS-110)

steps.activity: SCM/Logistics plan RTI retrieval from external locations (stores, customers, carriers): identify RTI overdue/at-external (W3531), schedule backhaul/retrieval on outbound trucks (links to VS-06/W3507 backhaul), and prioritize high-value/high-shortage RTI; integrate to reverse logistics (links to VS-32)

DC/Logistics/Carrier execute retrieval: collect RTI on delivery backhaul (links to VS-06), scan in on return to DC (W3531), sort/inspect/repair (W3533), and return to pool; manage customer/carrier-located RTI recovery (W3532) and escalation

SCM/Finance measure RTI cycle time, return rate, retrieval cost, and loss (W3533); optimize the reverse network and backhaul utilization (links to VS-110/W3507); report to analytics (W3540) and governance (W3544)

fields.Participants: Finance (links to VS-17/VS-15), SCM, Procurement (links to VS-03), Logistics (links to VS-06), Pool Provider, AP (links to VS-15)
fields.Trigger: Pool-provider billing cycle (rented pool); monthly reconciliation

workflows.name: Pallet / RTI Pool Reconciliation & Pool-Provider Settlement

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-scan of "scan errors, unreturned, timing" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validate fees/charges vs contract" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report pool-provider performance, cost, and loss rate to analytics" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: reconciliation and audit; operational: tracking and recovery
Pain Points / Risks: - **Billing-error risk**: Pool-provider over-billing (wrong counts, phantom trips); mitigated by reconciliation and audit
- **Hidden-loss cost risk**: Unmanaged pool loss inflates fees; mitigated by tracking and recovery
System Touchpoints: - Pool-provider billing; RTI tracking (links to W3531); AP/GL (links to VS-15/VS-17.1); cost allocation (links to W3514/VS-72); procurement/contract (links to VS-03/VS-34); vendor scorecard (links to VS-67)

steps.activity: SCM/Finance reconcile the pool-provider account: issued/returned/lost pallets or RTI per the provider's records vs BuildRight's tracking (W3531), per-trip/day fees, loss/damage charges, and deposits; resolve discrepancies (scan errors, unreturned, timing)

Finance/AP process the pool-provider invoice (links to VS-15/W7), validate fees/charges vs contract (links to VS-03/VS-34), dispute errors, and allocate pool cost to operations/entities (links to W3514/VS-72); post to GL (links to VS-17.1)

SCM/Finance report pool-provider performance, cost, and loss rate to analytics (W3540) and governance (W3544); evaluate own-vs-rent economics periodically (W3529) and manage provider QBR (links to VS-67)
